description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods on the RoBERTa base and large models. The x-axis represents the fine-tuning methods, which include LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S2-model, and S5-model. The y-axis indicates the performance, measured by the F1 score, ranging from approximately 86 to 88. The base model shows a performance of around 86, while the large model performs slightly better, with a performance of about 88. The LoRA method shows a performance of around 87, BitFit around 86.5, S1-model around 87.5, S2-model around 87, and S5-model shows the highest performance at approximately 88. The chart suggests that the S5-model, when applied to the large model, achieves the highest performance among the methods tested.
